name: silhouette
description: Silhouette: a research-backed style studio and dress-up game (React + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @silhouette/engine && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
